policy.replication: preserve node separation, backups and required durability; never shrink PVCs in place
policy.hibernated_exception: stockpilot-postgres remains hibernated; its prior restore/snapshot retirement is already documented

stages.state: deployed, 2/2 healthy, replication lag zero, public discovery HTTP 200
stages.disk_retirement: two Released PVs, 20Gi data + 8Gi WAL; original disks still charged
stages.remaining: approve exact detached-disk retirement after recovery review

stages.state: backup IAM and database-only metadata egress deployed; 3/3 healthy
stages.recovery: one-off physical backup/WAL restore job prepared; reduce to two only after successful recovery

stages.state: destination on global prepared; 135-table restore rehearsal, sequence and permission equality passed; source still serves production
stages.destination: global-postgres-pooler-rw.global.svc.cluster.local / homechef_db for API and worker; direct global primary for company admin/bootstrap
stages.durability_decision: source enforces minSyncReplicas=1; global configured 0/1; user choice pending before cutover
stages.maintenance: approved for API, worker, company, schema bootstrap; not started
stages.rollback: before target writes, resume source; after target writes, pause and reconcile new data before any return
stages.retention: preserve old source through agreed fallback window; independent archive retained; no source disk deletion approved

constraints: 5GB max_slot_wal_keep_size requires WAL startup headroom; do not shrink to 5Gi
use separate smaller cluster; do not disable the CNPG validating webhook
preserve platform_api, marketplace_api, openfga and mark8ly_platform_admin roles and OpenBao credential equality
pause APIs, auth/database consumers, all writing CronJobs and company admin during final copy
verify all three databases, sequences, ownership/grants and real consumers before retiring source
size memory and connection budgets from peak measurements; a small dataset alone does not justify changing them
stages.remaining: prepare complete replacement and consumer manifests before named maintenance/replacement approval

billing_limits: Retained disks are still billed after replica reduction or hibernation
Potential capacity reductions are not realized savings until approved disk retirement
Existing compute commitments remain payable even if node count falls
No backup retention, cross-zone replication or application data is removed to meet a nominal disk target
